signature: SUBROUTINE DORGTR( UPLO, N, A, LDA, TAU, WORK, LWORK, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A contains elementary reflectors from DSYTRD;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A contains elementary reflectors from DSYTRD.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix Q. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the vectors which define the elementary reflectors, as returned by DSYTRD. On exit, the N-by-N orthogonal matrix Q.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by DSYTRD.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N-1)$. For optimum performance $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge (N-1) \, \mathrm{NB}$, where NB is the optimal blocksize.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
